notablePrerequisites: Mechanized Production attached to Strionic Resonator.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Mechanized Production trigger.
Resolve the copy of Mechanized Production's ability, creating a token copy of Strionic Resonator.
Activate the Strionic Resonator token by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Mechanized Production trigger.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Strionic Resonator token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.
